title: NSClient History time-axis wrong scaling
body:
Problem
--------------
The time-axis in the history window is not scaled properly for all hourly-steps.
The time difference between the vertical grid lines is not always constant.


Comment
--------------
The plot scaling seems to be ok.
Can be seen with the SMBs given between 4:55 and 5:11


Examples - wrong grid
--------------
between 4 and 5 o'clock only one hour difference instead of 2
![Screenshot_20230927-062114](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/8597725/2885f2cb-af98-4b5c-bb96-3bdacf07e296)


between 7 and 10 o'clock 3 hours difference instead of 2
![Screenshot_20231002-082624](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/8597725/1b53a1f3-1f25-4d67-93ce-609cff16dce6)


between 8 and 12 o'clock 4 hours difference instead of 3
![Screenshot_20231002-082746](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/8597725/1885739c-98bb-4f1f-a00e-49346939629f)


Examples - plot scaling seems to be ok
--------------
![Screenshot_20230927-062223](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/8597725/27a61286-3ae2-4f36-83e4-d457d3a332f0)
![Screenshot_20230927-062114](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/8597725/9b7f4ff0-0e4e-4a6f-9fbf-ab5eceec3ddf)

comments.body: wasn't it day of DST change?

No, that's what i first thought, also.
But DST change will be oct 29th 2023 only (in one month).

I think the plot is scaled correctly. 
But the ticks of the vertical grid lines are not equidistant within the graph.
Should be e.g.:  0 - 2 - 4 - 6 ... o'clock
But is:                0 - 2 - 5 - 7 ... o'clock
